tool_args.rationale: The reported high-frequency sign-oscillation signature calls for scoped abstention. The paid observations also rule out the sign behavior of all three recalled laws, so there is no supported forecast model to submit for confirmation at RMSE 0.045.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Finer sampling could characterize the oscillations, but the observed nonstationary signature does not warrant spending 4.5 to distinguish stationary models.
The auxiliary measurement does not test the source of the sign oscillations.
These exponential forms cannot produce the observed mixed signs with a fixed prefactor or a positive initial state.
With positive u_now, the model permits at most one sign change as H increases; the paid rows show three.
